captureAuth.description: Capture the dashboard's short-lived Bearer Authorization header from a live tRPC request (reloads the signed-in tab and reads Network.requestWillBeSent). Returns the value to the caller in memory only: it is never written to disk or logged. The other tools call this themselves; call it directly only to force a refresh.

force.description: re-sniff even when a header is already cached

returns.description: the Authorization header value; never print it

usageBreakdown.description: Daily http usage buckets for one dimension, via usage.getBillingUsageBreakdownTimeseries. The only per-app / per-method / per-network source: the free plan's @alchemy/cli refuses --group-by and --filters. Raises on a non-200 (401 = stale header or signed-out tab) instead of retrying.

auth.description: override the captured header; used for the 401 negative control

apps.description: sid to app-name map, via apps.getApps. Resolves the opaque sid keys an appId breakdown returns. Names only: the raw response also carries each app's live API key, which this tool drops.

summarize.description: Fold a breakdown timeseries into per-key totals. Pure: no page, no network, no auth.
